name: Purchasing
description: Purchase orders with Thai VAT, approval, goods receipt (full or partial), returns to supplier, supplier bills (payables & aging), supplier payments with withholding tax, 50 ทวิ certificates and the monthly ภ.ง.ด.3 / ภ.ง.ด.53 attachment. Feeds Inventory (stock in), Costing (actual material cost) and Accounting (AP, input VAT, WHT payable) when installed.
